note: Drafts only: no URA analytical database is connected. A data owner certifies an entry by setting status to certified and filling certified_by and certified_at (ADR-0033).

metrics.title: Returns filed on time, by tax head and period
metrics.description: Share of returns due in each period that were filed by the due date, for each tax head.
metrics.sql: SELECT tax_head, period, filed_on_time_ratio, returns_due AS group_size FROM certified.filing_compliance WHERE period BETWEEN :period_from AND :period_to ORDER BY tax_head, period

metrics.title: EFRIS e-invoicing adoption, by sector
metrics.description: Share of VAT-registered businesses in each sector issuing e-invoices through EFRIS in a period.
metrics.sql: SELECT sector, efris_active_ratio, vat_registered AS group_size FROM certified.efris_adoption WHERE period = :period ORDER BY sector
